summary: Create one scoped Markdown instruction without overwriting an existing file, or apply one explicitly owner-admitted revision-guarded guidance append to an existing canonical instruction.

output.description: Scaffold results preserve the no-overwrite fields; adaptation results additionally expose status, mutation_applied, expected/current/post authority revisions, owner admission, validation status/failures, and rollback restoration fields.

reads.description: current bytes and revision for an explicitly owner-admitted adaptation

writes.when: the destination does not exist and adaptation mode is absent
adaptation mode is apply, owner admission is explicit, the expected revision matches, and static applicability validation passes
writes.description: one canonical guidance append; pre-apply bytes are restored on failed validation

steps.description: Create through the no-overwrite scoped instruction semantic owner.

guards: Reject invalid names and repository-relative path patterns.
Never overwrite an existing instruction file during scaffold creation.

Adaptation never auto-promotes: it requires an explicit admitted owner identity, an exact current revision, one existing Markdown authority inside .agentic-workspace/instructions, and either a bounded append_guidance delta or source-owned semantic disposition.
Retain, defer, and dismiss persist a candidate- and source-semantic-revision-bound disposition in the canonical instruction; a source semantic or re-entry-trigger change reactivates the candidate.
Validate instruction syntax plus declared positive and negative applicability after mutation; restore pre-apply bytes on any failure.
proof: generated Python and TypeScript operation clients preserve the no-overwrite boundary

bounded adaptation tests cover explicit admission, canonical mutation, fresh revision, static applicability, stale revision, unsafe rejection, rollback, quiet/superseded disposition, and no automatic promotion
